hero_title: ENGINEERING THAT TRANSFORMS OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS INTO AIR NAVIGATION SOLUTIONS.
hero_sub: GIDEA specialises in instrument flight procedure design, airspace engineering, and aerodrome & heliport environment analysis.
sec1_lead: Specialised design of instrument flight procedures considering operational requirements, aerodrome & heliport characteristics, airspace environment, and applicable ICAO & FAA design criteria.
card1_text: Fixed-wing and helicopter Point-in-Space (PinS) trajectory design, aircraft performance analysis, and obstacle assessment.
card2_text: Design based on conventional navigation aids (VOR, NDB, ILS/DME), ensuring obstacle clearance and operational minima.
card3_text: RNAV and RNP procedure design according to ICAO Doc 8168, Doc 9613 and FAA Order 8260. Includes ARINC 424 coding, RNP APCH and advanced PBN solutions.
card4_text: Design for complex aerodrome environments, maximising airspace utilisation with curved and RF leg segments.
sec2_title: AERODROME & HELIPORT ENVIRONMENT ENGINEERING & OPERATIONAL SAFETY
sec2_lead: Aeronautical studies and engineering solutions to assess the feasibility, operation and aeronautical impact of aerodromes, heliports, and planned infrastructure developments.
box1_text: Assessment of site alternatives for new aerodromes, urban, hospital and offshore heliports, infrastructure and projects requiring specific aeronautical conditions.
box2_text: Operational safety risk assessments (ICAO Doc 9859 / SMS) associated with changes in procedures, airspace structure, infrastructure or flight operations.
box3_text: Assessment of the aeronautical impact of constructions, urban developments, wind farms and installations on aerodrome and heliport operations (ICAO Annex 14 Vol I & II, FAA AC 150/5390).
box4_text: Integrated evaluations of the interaction between aerodrome/heliport, aircraft performance, infrastructure, airspace structure and instrument flight procedures.
cap1_text: Aeronautical feasibility assessment, site selection and instrument procedure design (including PinS) from initial planning stages.
cap2_text: Analysis and redesign of ATS routes, TMA structures and terminal area procedures.
cap3_text: Review and improvement of existing instrument flight procedure structures.
cap4_text: Evaluation of the aeronautical impact of infrastructure modifications on flight operations.
cap5_text: Proprietary tools for procedure calculations and technical validation.
sec4_lead: Technical Rigour · Data Integrity · Operational Safety

std2_text: Flight procedure design quality assurance process aligned with ICAO Doc 9906 and international aviation standards.
std3_text: Every technical process is supported by a complete Technical Dossier ensuring full design traceability.

partners_lead: GIDEA focuses on core Instrument Flight Procedure Design (IFPD) and integrates comprehensive airport engineering through strategic specialized alliances.
partner1_desc: Consultancy firm specialised in aerodrome master planning, runway and taxiway pavements, airside/landside facilities, and the AeroGEN software platform.
partner1_synergy: Turnkey solutions uniting physical airport infrastructure engineering with instrument flight procedure design.
partner2_desc: Specialized aerospace engineering research with expertise in operational modeling, OLS, and airport capacity.
partner2_synergy: State-of-the-art scientific backing for complex airspace and obstacle limitation studies.
partner3_desc: Strategic agreements for airborne flight validation (ICAO Doc 9906 Quality Assurance) and high-precision WGS-84 / LiDAR geodetic obstacle surveys.
partner3_synergy: Ensures the complete lifecycle of instrument procedures through to official civil aviation authority approval and AIP publication.
ifpd_lead: Technical development, obstacle clearance assessment, and periodic maintenance of visual and instrument flight procedures adhering strictly to ICAO Doc 8168 (PANS-OPS Vol. II) and FAA Order 8260 (TERPS) criteria.
ifpd_sec1_lead: Analytical modeling of nominal tracks, turn protection areas, climb gradients, and minimum obstacle clearance (MOC) for fixed-wing aircraft and helicopters.
ifpd_card1_text: RNP APCH (LNAV, LNAV/VNAV, LP/LPV), RNP AR APCH with Radius-to-Fix (RF) curved legs for terrain-constrained environments, and RNAV 1 / RNP 1 terminal routes (SID & STAR).
ifpd_card2_text: Precision approaches: ILS (Cat I, II, III) with OAS and CRM collision risk models, and non-precision VOR/DME, NDB, and Localizer (LOC) with missed approach segments.
ifpd_card3_text: Point-in-Space (PinS) approach and departure procedures for urban, hospital, and offshore heliports under ICAO Doc 8168 Vol. II and Annex 14 Vol. II.
ifpd_card4_text: Independent ground validation, navigation database ARINC 424 coding sheets, and aeronautical charting compliant with ICAO Annex 4.
ifpd_sec2_lead: Every procedure engineered by GIDEA LLC is backed by an auditable Design Dossier ensuring 100% data integrity and traceability before Civil Aviation Authorities.
ifpd_dossier1_text: Detailed obstacle clearance sheets, WGS-84 coordinate verification, and operational minima determination (DA/H, MDA/H).
ifpd_dossier2_text: Path & Terminator specifications, waypoint attributes, altitude and speed constraints formatted for FMS navigation databases.
ifpd_dossier3_text: Instrument approach, departure, and arrival charts formatted ready for state AIP publication by the civil aviation authority.
